key_insight: The paper introduces WBCMor VQA, a bilingual English–Urdu visual question answering benchmark for white blood cell morphology to support multilingual hematology AI.
clinical_relevance: It addresses a practical language gap in healthcare settings where patients and clinicians may use different languages, especially in Pakistan and similar South Asian contexts.
method: Built a clinically validated bilingual VQA dataset for leukemia and normal white blood cell analysis.
Used morphology-aware annotations from LeukemiaAttri and WBCAtt datasets.
Added a domain-specific Urdu hematology dictionary to keep terminology consistent and clinically accurate.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 110K bilingual question-answer pairs for 20K leukemic and normal single-cell images, and the authors evaluated multiple open-source VLMs as baselines.
watch_item: As with any new benchmark, real-world performance may still depend on Urdu terminology standardization and careful clinical validation across diverse sites.
paper_title: Multilingual Hematology Visual Question Answering Dataset
